title: The Well of Old Chapel Road
author: Juniper Lockridge
blurb: Ansel Dravenmoor, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the last resident signs the papers.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
